messages:
Maria (CS): FYI — Northbridge renewal hit a snag. They need the invoice split between US and EU entities and want the 9mo term rollover. Procurement asked for vendor codes + net30 PO. Can finance/legal advise on signature path? Docs: https://redwood.app/threads/northbridge-renewal
Ethan (AE): On it. CFO wants charge on US entity but EU subsidiary will sign. They have a delegated signer for EU; need vendorcode 12345. Waiting on procurement to confirm PO.
Jin (Finance): We can split invoices but need billing entity GUID. Send me the exact seat counts and pricing line items. For PO routing, we need vendor code + tax id.
Maria (CS): Seats: 250 total. Proposed split: 180 US, 70 EU. Pricing same as previous: $0.004/token gen. Amendment snippet below:
Maria (CS): ```Amendment: The Parties agree to split billing as follows: US entity (Northbridge Inc) 180 seats; EU entity (Northbridge EU) 70 seats. Invoices will be issued separately per legal entity.``` 
Samira (Legal): We need a delegated signature authorization doc from EU legal. Also confirm Docusign envelope signer email and entity name. If EU requires EUID, attach.
Docusign Bot: Envelope 0x9c45 uploaded by Ethan. https://docusign.com/envelope/0x9c45 :waiting_for_signer:
Aj Taylor: Quick check — for private deployment keys (KMS), do they need key per entity? That impacts billing commit. @Jin do we need separate KMS invoices?
Jin (Finance): KMS billed to the entity owning keys. If they put keys in one entity, contract wise we need that entity on the invoice. Recommend two KMS aliases if they want isolation.
Ethan (AE): Procurement confirmed vendorcode 67890 for EU. Tax ID for EU is EU-TID-8876. Sending PO copy in thread.
Maria (CS): Thanks. Action items: 1) Ethan to upload PO & confirm signer emails; 2) Samira to review delegated signer doc; 3) Jin to prep two invoices draft; 4) I will update CSM playbook and schedule enablement call next Wed. ETA Friday for docs.
Samira (Legal): I'll approve delegated signer if they provide board resolution or power of attorney. Send redline deadline 48h.
Jin (Finance): Draft invoices will be in DocuSign as separate attachments. ETA 24h after PO.
Ethan (AE): PO uploaded: https://files.company/po-northbridge.pdf — signer for EU: laura@northbridge.eu, US signer: cfo@northbridge.com
Maria (CS): Great. @docusign-bot can you re-route envelope to laura@northbridge.eu and cfo@northbridge.com as signers on separate envelopes? We need separate flow.
Docusign Bot: Routing updated — Envelope US: 0x9c46, Envelope EU: 0x9c47. Status: sent.
Maria (CS): Noted. I'll add enablement invite once US envelope lands signed. Thanks team :thumbsup:
